_doc: Ways to make each thing an edit needs. Scores 1-5 (higher is better). `requires`: all must be met; 'a|b' = either. cost: free | subscription (owner's plan quota) | credits (metered: always ask) | paid (API key). licence: own | cc | stock | ai-service | check. privacy: local | uploads. Claude ranks with `vedit route plan <need>`, mixes routes freely, logs outcomes with `vedit route log`. Personal additions: personal/routes.json or personal/extensions/*.py ROUTES.

icon.label: Claude draws an SVG icon/element
icon.how: Write SVG inline in a composition or edit/custom/<name>.svg; animate with GSAP. Best for flat/line icons, arrows, shapes, badges.

icon.label: Iconify / Lucide / Phosphor open icon sets
Logged-in web AI (Gemini, ChatGPT, Ideogram, Firefly...) on a flat background
icon.how:
references/webai.md: style-consistent prompt, `vedit inbox mark`, generate + download, `vedit inbox pull

--service --prompt ...`, remove background (Canva or chroma), `vedit inbox vectorize` for SVG.

icon.label: Canva generate-image (+ remove-background)
icon.how: Canva MCP generate-image, then remove-background; export PNG.

image.label: Claude-made illustration (SVG/HTML/Canvas/shader)
image.how: Composition in edit/custom/*.html rendered as still or animation. Abstract backgrounds, diagrams, UI mockups, gradients, data art.

image.label: Openverse / Wikimedia Commons (CC, public domain)
image.how:
`vedit sources search ` then `vedit sources get

--pick N`; licence flags + attribution logged; `vedit sources credits

` for the description.

image.label: Pexels / Pixabay
image.how: `vedit sources search <words> --provider pexels pixabay [--orientation portrait]`, `vedit sources get`.

image.label: Google Images, Pinterest, Behance, Unsplash via the browser
image.how: references/sourcing.md: mood board first, download with provenance, flag unclear licences.

image.label: Logged-in web AI image (Gemini/Imagen, ChatGPT, Firefly, Ideogram, Leonardo, Krea, Freepik)
image.how:
references/webai.md: `vedit inbox mark`, generate in the owner's logged-in tab, download, `vedit inbox pull

--service --prompt ... --register`.

image.label: Gemini API image generation (free tier key)
image.how: Gemini image model through the owner's AI Studio key.

scene_clip.label: Owner's footage / B-roll library
scene_clip.how: `vedit memory ask "<what is said>"` finds the moment in any footage ever transcribed; `vedit assets search` for tagged clips; `vedit watch` to see it.

scene_clip.label: Illustrated animated scene as b-roll or an insert (vedit anim)
scene_clip.how:
`vedit anim add

--as insert --at `: acts an idea out (a process, a history, a comparison) while the speaker keeps talking.

scene_clip.label: Claude-made animated scene (HTML/GSAP/Three.js/Canvas)
scene_clip.how: Full-frame composition: abstract motion, kinetic typography, UI walkthroughs, 2.5D parallax of stills, 3D product cards.

scene_clip.label: Pexels / Pixabay video
scene_clip.how: `vedit sources search <words> --kind video --provider pexels pixabay` (Wikimedia has some CC video too).

scene_clip.label: Logged-in web AI video (Gemini Veo, Runway, Kling, Luma)
scene_clip.how: Always ask first (quota/credits). Silent clips; add sound in vedit.

animation.label: Illustrated animation in a shipped style (cut paper, crosshatch, riso, sketchbook, math, pixel, isometric)
animation.how:
`vedit anim new

--style ` -> story / look / storyboard check-ins -> `vedit anim render|review` -> `vedit anim add --as insert|short|overlay`. Explainers, histories, little stories, product reels; Bangla and English. references/animation.md

animation.label: Animation in a new look matched from the owner's references
animation.how: anim/grammar/new-style.md: `vedit anim measure|shotlog|compare`, matched frames approved by the owner, then `vedit anim save-style`. New ground until it has carried a piece.

animation.label: Claude-made animated scene (HTML/GSAP/Three.js/Canvas)
animation.how: Full-frame composition: abstract motion, kinetic typography, UI walkthroughs, 2.5D parallax of stills, 3D product cards.

animation.label: Logged-in web AI video (Gemini Veo, Runway, Kling, Luma)
animation.how: Always ask first (quota/credits). Silent clips; add sound in vedit.

motion_graphic.label: Shipped or personal template
motion_graphic.how: `vedit mg templates`; personal ones from `vedit template save`.

motion_graphic.label: Custom composition written for this moment (HTML/GSAP/SVG/Canvas)
motion_graphic.how: edit/custom/<id>.html -> Overlay.mg.file. How good edits become excellent.

motion_graphic.label: Remotion (React)
motion_graphic.how: mg/remotion; licence note for companies > 3 people.

motion_graphic.label: LottieFiles animation (lottie-web)
motion_graphic.how: Download .json (Lottie Simple License / CC), play with lottie-web in a composition.

motion_graphic.label: CapCut text/animation preset (in the CapCut hand-off)
motion_graphic.how: TextItem.capcut_intro etc.; only appears in the CapCut project.

motion_graphic.label: Hand-drawn doodles over footage: arrows, circles, notes in a style's ink
motion_graphic.how:
`vedit anim new

--overlay --style crosshatch|sketchbook` then `vedit anim add --as overlay --at `.

3d.label: Three.js 3D template or composition (titles incl. Bangla, logos, product, device, particles, fly-through, chart, globe)
3d.how: mg templates title_3d / logo_3d / product_spin / device_mockup / particles / camera_flythrough / chart_3d / globe (references/vfx.md); custom: edit/custom/*.html with three-kit.js. Renders ~5 frames/s at 1080x1920, live in the Studio.

3d.label: Blender headless render (real bevels, extrusion, light, product turntables)
3d.how: overlay mg {engine: blender, template: title_3d|logo_3d|product_turntable} or CustomFX kind=blender; `vedit blender render`. Latin text only; ~2 s per frame at 540p here (heroes, not every graphic).

vfx.label: Tracking: labels that follow, tracked blur (faces, plates, objects)
vfx.how: `vedit vfx track|faces|blur|attach` (optical flow + VitTrack, YuNet faces); check with `vedit vfx sheet`.

vfx.label: Screen / sign replacement (four-corner plane tracking)
vfx.how: `vedit vfx screen --suggest` then `--corners ... --media ...`, or corners picked in the Studio + `vedit vfx prepare`.

vfx.label: Person cut-out: text behind the person, background blur / swap, outline, glow
vfx.how: `vedit vfx subject` (MODNet, ~3 frames/s here); still cut-outs `vedit vfx cutout` (BiRefNet if downloaded).

vfx.label: Depth: 3D photo parallax, depth of field
Camera FX: whip / zoom-blur transitions, motion blur, handheld drift, shake, stabilize
Canva background removal (stills)
vfx.how: Canva remove-background on a still; ask before uploading the owner's photos.

vfx.label: Custom Python FX (numpy/OpenCV per frame -> alpha overlay)
vfx.how: CustomFX kind=python; `vedit fx save` to reuse.

vfx.label: FFmpeg filter chain at a render hook
vfx.how: CustomFX kind=ffmpeg (glitch, grain, vignette, chromatic shift, blur, curves).

vfx.label: CapCut effect / tracking in the CapCut hand-off
vfx.how: EffectItem.capcut; tracking done by the owner in CapCut.

music.label: Rank candidate tracks by description (earshot ears)
music.how: Candidates from the library or sources, then `earshot rank` via `vedit sound` (ears installed).

music.label: Openverse / Wikimedia audio (CC)
music.how: `vedit sources search <mood> --kind audio`; NC licences are dropped unless --any-licence; attribution in credits.

music.label: YouTube Audio Library, Pixabay Music, Uppbeat (free tiers) via the browser
Suno / Udio (logged in)
music.how: Free tiers are non-commercial: flag before publishing.

music.label: Music made in code, shaped by the edit (vedit score)
music.how:
`vedit score compose

--mood warm|tense|upbeat|lofi|epic|minimal|playful`; a `payoff` marker gets the silence before it and the loudest hit on it. A fallback bed: the owner listens.

sfx.label: earshot kit (252 code-made sounds, measured sync points)
sfx.how:
`vedit sound cues

` then `vedit sound place

[--kit crisp|calm|launch|minimal]`; `vedit sound find ` for single sounds.

sfx.label: Freesound (CC, needs login to download)
sfx.how: Browser or `vedit sources search <words> --kind audio` (Openverse indexes Freesound); CC0 / CC-BY only; never log in for the owner.

voiceover.label: The owner records it
voiceover.how: Script with the writing pass, then transcribe.

voiceover.label: Offline voices: Kokoro (English + 7 languages), offline Bangla (two models)
voiceover.how:
`vedit voice vo

--voice kokoro:af_heart|bn_coqui:female|bn_mimic3:3 --file script.txt` (references/voices.md); check each voice's commercial flag.

voiceover.label: Microsoft Edge voices (best free Bangla: bn-BD Nabanita / Pradeep), online
voiceover.how:
`vedit voice vo

--voice edge:bn-BD-PradeepNeural`; exact word timings; the script goes to Microsoft; commercial terms unclear (flagged).

voiceover.label: The owner's cloned voice, offline (Pocket TTS English; OpenVoice for any language)
voiceover.how: `vedit voice clone <name> --files ... --consent ...` once, then pocket:<name> or openvoice:<name>@edge:bn-BD-PradeepNeural. Consent in words, always.

font.label: Google Fonts via the browser
font.how: Download the TTF into the project, log OFL licence.

thumbnail.label: Best frame + Claude-designed composition
thumbnail.how: `vedit thumbnail frames|make`; custom HTML for bespoke layouts.

thumbnail.label: Canva design with the owner's brand kit
thumbnail.how: Canva MCP generate-design / brand templates, export PNG.

thumbnail.label: Web AI key art + native text overlay
thumbnail.how: Generate background/subject art; set the text natively for crisp type.

color_look.label: .cube LUT (owner's or Claude-generated)
color_look.how: edit.color.lut; phase 3 exports presets as LUTs.

color_look.label: Match a reference still/look
color_look.how: Custom python FX or curves/eq derived from `vedit style analyze` stats.

background_removal.label: Generate or shoot on a flat background, then key it out
background_removal.how: Ask web AIs for a pure white or #00FF00 background; `vedit inbox key <png>` (or Overlay.chroma; `vedit inbox vectorize` for icons. Verified with a Gemini icon on 2026-10-31.

background_removal.label: Canva remove-background (stills)
background_removal.how: Upload bytes with create-upload-url + an octet-stream POST (Canva cannot fetch Wikimedia URLs), then remove-background. The connector returns only a ~200 px preview: full size needs the cut-out placed in a Canva design and exported as PNG with a transparent background (Pro). Best for thumbnails and designs built in Canva; for video elements prefer flat_key or native_matte.

research.label: Mood board from Pinterest, Behance, Dribbble, Google, YouTube
Watch a reference video (keyframes + transcript)
research.how: `vedit fetch <url> --to <folder>` (reference only: copyrighted) then `vedit watch <file> --file`; read the grids and transcript; `vedit technique save`.

research.label: Web search for techniques and tutorials
research.how: Then rebuild natively and `vedit technique save`.

critique.label: Second opinion: Gemini watches the render (logged in)
critique.how: Ask per project: the video leaves the PC.

critique.label: Parallel critic lenses (subagents)
critique.how: Only when the owner asks for agents.
